The Arboretum at Estancia La Constancia is open to experiences that combine
**conservation, environmental education and wellbeing**. Choose the one that
interests you most and we'll arrange a date.

::: {.callout-tip}
Would you like to book or ask a question? Write to us from the
[**Contact**](contact.html) page and we'll reply shortly.
:::

## Our experiences

::: grid

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-tree"></i> Guided and educational visits
Tours led by professionals for **families, schools and groups**, adapted by level and
goal. Ideal to complement natural science, biology and environmental education
content.

[See educational visits →](educational-visits.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"}
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-flower2"></i> Guided botanical group tours
Guided walks through the arboretum's collections —conifers, broadleaf trees, shrubs
and palms— for the general public, clubs, nurseries, gardeners and botany
enthusiasts.

[Book / enquire →](guided-tours.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"}
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-binoculars"></i> Birdwatching
Observation and photography outings for **birdwatchers and photographers**, guided by
the estate's seasonal species record.

[See the arboretum's birds →](birds.html){.btn .btn-outline-success role="button"}
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-flower1"></i> Wellbeing and forest bathing
Guided nature-connection experiences (*shinrin-yoku*), backed by science, for
individuals and teams looking to reduce stress and reconnect.

[Learn more →](wellbeing.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"}
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-people"></i> Corporate programs
Impact partnerships, wellbeing days, corporate volunteering and sponsorship of
arboretum projects, with traceable and verifiable impact.

[See the proposal for companies →](companies.html){.btn .btn-outline-success role="button"}
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### 🎉 Corporate events
Team-building, offsites, celebrations and productions in a 33-hectare botanical
garden, minutes from Mar del Plata.

[See corporate events →](events.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"}
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### 🌱 Sponsor a tree
Join conservation by sponsoring a specimen, in your own name, as a gift or in honour
of someone.

[Sponsor a tree →](sponsor.html){.btn .btn-outline-success role="button"}
:::

:::

---

All experiences are **by advance booking**, to ensure good organization and the best
experience for each group.
